system.description:
You filter Water as it enters your lungs, being able to breathe as if you were a fish. You can breathe in water as if you were breathing air.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, increase its duration to 1 Hour. If this jutsu is Cast at B-Rank or higher, its range instead becomes Self (10-Foot Radius) affected all willing creatures in range.
